title: Hezekiah shows the Babylonian envoys his treasures
description: King Hezekiah receives envoys from Merodach-Baladan of Babylon and shows them his entire treasury and armory. The prophet Isaiah then declares that everything will be carried off to Babylon, and that Hezekiah's sons will become eunuchs there. Hezekiah accepts the word and finds comfort in the fact that there will be peace during his own lifetime.
